title: Bound the entire inviscid physical shear with sharp linear growth
statement: For b=A(t)cos(2pi x2)e1,Theta=integral A, every mean-zero divergence-free v0 in H1 obeys ||v(t)||2<=100(1+|Theta|)||v0||H1 under the full INVISCID physical linearization, cutoff independently. For p,m,l,r^2=p^2+l^2,D=r^2+m^2,q=1-1/D use omega=DV and zeta=2pi i(l v1-p v3). For r^2>=2 the sqrt(q)omega energy is conserved and incompressibility supplies one derivative. Critical r^2=1 has conservative side blocks and linearly growing neutral index; p=0 is lift-up and p=l=0 trivial. Example v0=e2 cos(2pi x3) has exact amplification sqrt(1+2pi^2 Theta^2), proving the exponent one sharp. This is H1-to-L2 INVISCID linear dynamics, not viscous/nonlinear or uniform L2-to-L2 contraction.
